violations.text: No person certified in food safety were present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026
Allergen statement is lacking on menu. Establishment added an allergen statement to menu at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Working containers of fruit are not labeled with the common name of the food located in prep unit. PIC labeled containers at time of inspection. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the (blender and mixer) have an accumulation of food residue, and other debris. PIC moved blender and mixer to 3-bay sink to wash, rinse and sanitize at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026
Multiple ceiling tiles in the back storage area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Observed employee storing personal food with establishment's food in refrigerator. PIC designated personal food to bottom drawer and right side of refrigerator for employee's personal food at time of inspection. Employee's personal food/items shall be kept separate from establishment's food/supplies. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026
Allergen statement is lacking on menu. Establishment is to add an allergen statement to menu. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2026

The door to the outside, located in the main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 05/08/2026
The door to the back toilet room is not self-closing. Toilet rooms must be self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026
The wall in the back storage area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026
